summary.text: Orderly Well is Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's immortal killer move that uses City Well. It modifies a secluded domain of heaven and earth by removing conflict between its dao marks and outside dao marks.

claims.text: In memories Fairy Zi Wei reads from Dang Hun Mountain, after Spectral Soul Demon Venerable becomes a venerable he places the mountain inside City Well and uses an immortal killer move to modify it. She names that move and notes that City Well, a rule path secluded domain of heaven and earth, clears the clash between Dang Hun Mountain’s soul path dao marks and external time path dao marks. City Well and this move are why sovereign immortal fetus Gu can hold non-conflicting dao marks. After the modification, Spectral Soul can restore the mountain with time path immortal killer moves.

Fang Yuan treats Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s Orderly Well as using City Well the way reverse flow protection seal uses Reverse Flow River. Both moves can activate because those secluded domains hold abundant dao marks that take the place of Gu worms, so the moves have progressed from killer moves toward Gu recipes. The Orderly Well cast Spectral Soul used on Dang Hun Mountain was rank nine.
Fang Yuan could pull up Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley because Spectral Soul Demon Venerable had modified both with Orderly Well; cloud bamboo mountain range had no such treatment.
While restoring Dang Hun Mountain, Fang Yuan experiences Orderly Well’s power and judges he could not have restored the mountain without Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s rank nine cast.
Unlike Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley, which have rank nine Orderly Well and can be repaired rapidly with Landscape as Before, Reverse Flow River is different and costly to restore.

Fang Yuan considers using it again: it is a rank nine move from Shadow Sect’s true inheritance, with City Well as the core, and it makes secluded domains easier to restore after dao mark conflict is cleared. Dang Hun Mountain, Luo Po Valley, and Miniscule Mountain have undergone the move. He never grasps it because he lacks its crucial core Immortal Gu, which is unique and already held by someone else, and the rank nine rule path move has no room for improvement he can see. Among secluded-domain cores he compares, this cast uses City Well to the highest degree, at the advanced level, though no killer move uses every dao mark in a secluded domain.
